paragraphs: I am a highly dedicated, organized, and learner-focused professional offering inspirational leadership. My expertise spans instructional design, project management, and cloud architecture, with a focus on leveraging technology to drive business and educational outcomes.

With a strong foundation in AWS and other cloud platforms, I believe in fostering a positive and innovative management environment. My goal is to contribute to projects that demand creative solutions and a deep understanding of cloud best practices.
